scope: fresh-0 through fresh-61; no overlap with the 28 previously verified records
limitations: Verified means the supplied Wikipedia page was read and supports the stated event, unless a stronger source is explicitly recorded. It is not a blanket independent primary-source investigation of every underlying news report.
No API keys, .env files, paid LLMs, or Git operations were used. Dataset and code were not edited.
No inherited record is marked unverified solely because a secondary URL was blocked; source limitations are retained in notes.
Proposed patches are ready for review. Primary quotations are short; supplied-source text is excerpted from the existing dataset.
